about: CATHEDRAL_SURVEY_MISDIRECTION_QUEST_1 ordinary play: a clan parked on Rust Cathedral ground, quarter-day polls (40 days). It mines quietly, then on day 5 sells two kyber crystals to a passing trader: Imperial Heat jumps over the low band and the Empire's survey team turns up on the plates and hails the ship. A month later it sells two more, and a second survey comes. The simulated player answers each hail as the test says (survey_responses); nothing is staged past any gate.
